newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Cemig still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Cemig still a hold.

text.p: -- Flemings Research said in a report it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazilian power utility Cemig.

-- It said Cemig's 1996 net earnings of 211 million reais were just bellow their 215 million reais net profit estimate, reflecting "an extremely poor year for generation" and power purchases from other generators.

-- In order to incorporate a reclassification of Cemig's operational costs, it lowered 1997 net profit and EBITDA estimates to 236.9 million reais and 729.6 million reais, respectively, from 266.7 million reais and 858.8 million reais, it said.

-- "A strategic plan may not be rolled out until 1998, so we encourage investors to hold onto their positions until there is more transparency regarding the trade buyers's plans and managerial maneuverability," it said.
-- Cemig preferred shares were trading at 46 reais, down 1.1 percent.
